queryLines:
SELECT CONCAT(
  CASE WHEN prob_chuva >= threshold_usado THEN '🌧️ Sim · ' ELSE '☀️ Não · ' END,
  CAST(ROUND(prob_chuva * 100) AS INT), '% às ', LPAD(CAST(HOUR(target_time) AS STRING), 2, '0'),
  'h (limiar ', CAST(ROUND(threshold_usado * 100) AS INT), '%)') AS `Próxima Hora`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml
WHERE target_time = (
  SELECT MIN(target_time) FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml
  WHERE target_time > from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')
)

datasets.name: a11b61da
datasets.displayName: Resumo de Alertas — hoje e amanhã
queryLines:
WITH modelo AS (
  -- última previsão feita antes de cada hora-alvo (mesma regra da view de acurácia)
  SELECT target_time, prob_chuva, prob_chuva_medida, threshold_regional,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY target_time ORDER BY inferencia_local DESC) AS rn
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml_history
  WHERE inferencia_local < target_time
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(wt.observation_time, 'dd/MM'), ' ',
         LPAD(CAST(wt.hour AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'h')               AS `Quando`,
  CASE WHEN wt.is_past THEN '✅ Observado' ELSE '🔮 Previsão' END  AS `Tipo`,
  ROUND(CAST(wt.temperature_2m AS DOUBLE), 1)                       AS `Temp (°C)`,
  ROUND(CAST(wt.apparent_temperature AS DOUBLE), 1)                 AS `Sensação (°C)`,
  CASE
    WHEN wt.temp_climatologica IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN wt.temperature_2m - wt.temp_climatologica >=  2 THEN '🔴 '
           WHEN wt.temperature_2m - wt.temp_climatologica <= -2 THEN '🔵 '
           ELSE '⚪ ' END,
      CASE WHEN wt.temperature_2m >= wt.temp_climatologica THEN '+' ELSE '' END,
      ROUND(wt.temperature_2m - wt.temp_climatologica, 1))
  END                                                               AS `Diferença p/ média histórica (°C)`,
  wt.temp_class                                                     AS `Faixa de temperatura`,
  CASE
    WHEN wt.precipitation IS NULL THEN '—'
    WHEN wt.precipitation = 0    THEN 'Sem chuva'
    ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(CAST(wt.precipitation AS DOUBLE), 1), ' mm · ', wt.rain_class)
  END                                                               AS `Chuva`,
  ROUND(CAST(wt.relative_humidity AS DOUBLE), 0)                    AS `Umidade (%)`,
  CASE
    WHEN m.prob_chuva IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN m.prob_chuva >= 0.85 THEN '🔴 '
           WHEN m.prob_chuva >= 0.65 THEN '🟠 '
           WHEN m.prob_chuva >= 0.40 THEN '🟡 '
           ELSE '🟢 ' END,
      CAST(ROUND(m.prob_chuva * 100) AS INT), '%')
  END                                                               AS `Modelo (chance de chuva)`,
  CASE
    WHEN m.prob_chuva_medida IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN m.prob_chuva_medida >= 0.9 THEN '🔴 '
           WHEN m.prob_chuva_medida >= m.threshold_regional THEN '🟠 '
           WHEN m.prob_chuva_medida >= m.threshold_regional - 0.2 THEN '🟡 '
           ELSE '🟢 ' END,
      CAST(ROUND(m.prob_chuva_medida * 100) AS INT), '%')
  END                                                               AS `Regional (chuva medida)`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.weather_today wt
LEFT JOIN modelo m
  ON m.target_time = wt.observation_time AND m.rn = 1
ORDER BY wt.observation_time

datasets.name: 0d8e8691
queryLines:
WITH ultima AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY target_time ORDER BY inferencia_local DESC) AS rn
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml_history
  WHERE target_time >  date_trunc('hour', from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) - INTERVAL 6 HOURS
    AND target_time <= date_trunc('hour', from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) + INTERVAL 18 HOURS
)
SELECT
  u.target_time                                          AS observation_time,
  CAST((unix_timestamp(u.target_time) - unix_timestamp(date_trunc('hour', from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')))) / 3600 AS INT) AS horas_rel,
  HOUR(u.target_time)                                    AS hora,
  ROUND(u.prob_chuva * 100, 1)                           AS prob_modelo_pct,
  ROUND(u.prob_chuva_medida * 100, 1)                    AS prob_regional_pct,
  u.threshold_usado * 100                                AS threshold_pct,
  CASE WHEN o.precipitation > 0 THEN 100
       WHEN o.precipitation = 0 THEN 0 END               AS choveu_real,
  ROUND(CAST(o.precipitation AS DOUBLE), 1)              AS chuva_real_mm
FROM ultima u
LEFT JOIN weather_pipeline.silver.weather_clean o
  ON o.observation_time = u.target_time AND o.observation_time <= from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')
WHERE u.rn = 1
ORDER BY u.target_time

datasets.name: a8420f1c
datasets.displayName: Desempenho: produção, API, teste e chuva medida (INMET)
queryLines:
-- Produção: horas com chuva observada em que há previsão do modelo E da API
-- (mesmas horas para os dois). Teste: últimos 12 meses fora do treino, no limiar do champion.
-- INMET: champion contra chuva medida nas cidades das estações (validação semanal).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pred_vai_chover, api_vai_chover, choveu FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_model_accuracy_hourly
  WHERE api_precip_alvo IS NOT NULL
),
conf AS (
  SELECT 'modelo' AS src, pred_vai_chover AS p, choveu AS c FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'api', api_vai_chover, choveu FROM base
),
agg AS (
  SELECT src, COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p = 1 AND c = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p = 0 AND c = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p = 1 AND c = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p = 0 AND c = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fn
  FROM conf GROUP BY src
),
met AS (
  SELECT s.src,
    COALESCE(a.n, 0) AS n, COALESCE(a.vp, 0) AS vp, COALESCE(a.vn, 0) AS vn,
    COALESCE(a.fp, 0) AS fp, COALESCE(a.fn, 0) AS fn,
    (a.vp + a.vn) / NULLIF(a.n, 0)          AS acc,
    a.vp / NULLIF(a.vp + a.fp, 0)           AS prec,
    a.vp / NULLIF(a.vp + a.fn, 0)           AS rec,
    2 * a.vp / NULLIF(2 * a.vp + a.fp + a.fn, 0) AS f1
  FROM (VALUES ('modelo'), ('api')) AS s(src)
  LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.src = s.src
),
inmet AS (
  -- última validação semanal do champion contra a chuva MEDIDA (INMET),
  -- média das cidades das estações, últimos 12 meses com dado
  SELECT avg(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN f1 END)            AS i_f1,
         avg(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN `precision` END)   AS i_prec,
         avg(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN recall END)        AS i_rec,
         avg(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN accuracy END)      AS i_acc,
         sum(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN test_size END)     AS i_n,
         count(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_chuva_medida_inmet' THEN 1 END)          AS i_cidades,
         avg(CASE WHEN variante LIKE '%_persistencia_inmet%' THEN f1 END)           AS p_f1
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.ml_experiments
  WHERE experimento = 'inmet_validacao'
    AND created_at = (SELECT max(created_at) FROM weather_pipeline.gold.ml_experiments
                      WHERE experimento = 'inmet_validacao')
),
reg AS (
  -- champion regional (rótulo = chuva medida): avaliação deixando cada estação de fora
  SELECT version AS r_ver, threshold AS r_thr, f1 AS r_f1, `precision` AS r_prec, recall AS r_rec,
         accuracy AS r_acc, test_size AS r_n
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_regional_versions
  WHERE promoted ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
),
champ AS (
  SELECT * FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_model_versions
  WHERE promoted ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
),
f AS (
  SELECT
    m.n, m.vp AS m_vp, m.vn AS m_vn, m.fp AS m_fp, m.fn AS m_fn,
    m.acc AS m_acc, m.prec AS m_prec, m.rec AS m_rec, m.f1 AS m_f1,
    a.vp AS a_vp, a.vn AS a_vn, a.fp AS a_fp, a.fn AS a_fn,
    a.acc AS a_acc, a.prec AS a_prec, a.rec AS a_rec, a.f1 AS a_f1,
    c.version AS ver, c.threshold AS v_thr, c.test_size AS v_n,
    c.accuracy AS v_acc, c.precision AS v_prec, c.recall AS v_rec, c.f1 AS v_f1
  , i.*, r.*
  FROM met m
  JOIN met a ON m.src = 'modelo' AND a.src = 'api'
  CROSS JOIN champ c
  CROSS JOIN inmet i
  CROSS JOIN reg r
)
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Observações (horas)' AS `Métrica`,
       CAST(n AS STRING) AS `Modelo (produção)`,
       CAST(n AS STRING) AS `API Open-Meteo (produção)`,
       CAST(v_n AS STRING) AS `Modelo (teste 12 meses)`,
       CONCAT(i_n, ' (', i_cidades, ' cidades)') AS `Modelo vs chuva medida (INMET)`,
       CONCAT(r_n, ' (estação fora do treino)') AS `Regional vs chuva medida (INMET)` FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Acurácia', CASE WHEN m_acc IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(m_acc * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN a_acc IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(a_acc * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN v_acc IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(v_acc * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN i_acc IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(i_acc * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN r_acc IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(r_acc * 100, 1), '%') END FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Precisão', CASE WHEN m_prec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(m_prec * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN a_prec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(a_prec * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN v_prec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(v_prec * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN i_prec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(i_prec * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN r_prec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(r_prec * 100, 1), '%') END FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Recall',   CASE WHEN m_rec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(m_rec * 100, 1), '%') END,  CASE WHEN a_rec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(a_rec * 100, 1), '%') END,  CASE WHEN v_rec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(v_rec * 100, 1), '%') END , CASE WHEN i_rec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(i_rec * 100, 1), '%') END, CASE WHEN r_rec IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(r_rec * 100, 1), '%') END FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'F1',       CASE WHEN m_f1 IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CAST(ROUND(m_f1, 3) AS STRING) END,   CASE WHEN a_f1 IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CAST(ROUND(a_f1, 3) AS STRING) END,   CASE WHEN v_f1 IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CAST(ROUND(v_f1, 3) AS STRING) END  , CASE WHEN i_f1 IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CAST(ROUND(i_f1, 3) AS STRING) END, CASE WHEN r_f1 IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CAST(ROUND(r_f1, 3) AS STRING) END FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'VP / VN / FP / FN',
       CONCAT(m_vp, ' / ', m_vn, ' / ', m_fp, ' / ', m_fn),
       CONCAT(a_vp, ' / ', a_vn, ' / ', a_fp, ' / ', a_fn), '—', '—', '—' FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Diagnóstico',
       CASE
         WHEN n < 48 THEN CONCAT('⏳ Amostra pequena (', n, ' h)')
         WHEN m_f1 >= v_f1 - 0.05 THEN '✅ Como na validação'
         WHEN m_f1 >= v_f1 - 0.15 THEN '⚠️ Abaixo da validação — monitorar'
         ELSE '🔴 Retreinamento recomendado'
       END,
       CASE
         WHEN n < 48 THEN '⏳ Aguardando amostra'
         WHEN COALESCE(m_f1, 0) > COALESCE(a_f1, 0) + 0.02 THEN '✅ Modelo supera a API'
         WHEN COALESCE(m_f1, 0) < COALESCE(a_f1, 0) - 0.02 THEN '⚠️ API supera o modelo'
         ELSE '≈ Empate com a API'
       END,
       CONCAT('v', ver, ' · limiar ', REPLACE(CAST(v_thr AS STRING), '.', ',')),
       CASE
         WHEN i_f1 IS NULL THEN '—'
         WHEN i_f1 >= p_f1 THEN CONCAT('✅ Supera a persistência do pluviômetro (F1 ', ROUND(p_f1, 2), ')')
         ELSE CONCAT('⚠️ Abaixo da persistência do pluviômetro (F1 ', ROUND(p_f1, 2), ')')
       END,
       CASE
         WHEN r_f1 IS NULL THEN '—'
         WHEN i_f1 IS NULL THEN CONCAT('v', r_ver, ' · limiar ', REPLACE(CAST(r_thr AS STRING), '.', ','))
         ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN r_f1 >= i_f1 THEN '✅ +' ELSE '⚠️ ' END,
                     ROUND(r_f1 - i_f1, 2), ' de F1 vs champion · v', r_ver,
                     ' · limiar ', REPLACE(CAST(r_thr AS STRING), '.', ','))
       END FROM f
ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: 46c331e3
queryLines:
SELECT
  month,
  CASE month
    WHEN 1  THEN 'Jan' 
    WHEN 2  THEN 'Fev' 
    WHEN 3  THEN 'Mar'
    WHEN 4  THEN 'Abr' 
    WHEN 5  THEN 'Mai' 
    WHEN 6  THEN 'Jun'
    WHEN 7  THEN 'Jul' 
    WHEN 8  THEN 'Ago'
    WHEN 9  THEN 'Set'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Out' 
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov' 
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Dez'
  END                  AS mes_nome,
  ROUND(AVG(temp_max), 1)  AS temp_max_media,
  ROUND(AVG(temp_avg), 1)  AS temp_media,
  ROUND(AVG(temp_min), 1)  AS temp_min_media
FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily
WHERE year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020   -- mesma referência das demais comparações
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: 6a3845f3
queryLines:
SELECT
  month,
  element_at(array('Jan', 'Fev', 'Mar', 'Abr', 'Mai', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Ago', 'Set', 'Out', 'Nov', 'Dez'), month) AS mes_nome,
  ROUND(AVG(precip_total), 1)                              AS precip_media_diaria,
  ROUND(SUM(precip_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT year), 1)       AS precip_media_mensal_acum,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(precip_total >= 1 AS INT)) * 100, 1)      AS pct_dias_com_chuva
FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily
WHERE year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020   -- mesma referência das demais comparações
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: st01
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) - unix_timestamp(MAX(inferencia_local))) / 60 <= 120   -- pipeline roda a cada hora: 🔴 com 2 h sem atualização
      THEN CONCAT('🟢 Atualizado às ', DATE_FORMAT(MAX(inferencia_local), 'HH:mm'))

  END AS `Status`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml

datasets.name: ac01
queryLines:
-- Chuva observada vs média 1991–2020 do mesmo período do calendário
WITH hoje AS (SELECT DATE(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS d),
dias7 AS (SELECT explode(sequence(date_sub(d, 6), d)) AS dd FROM hoje),
mtd AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.precip_total), 0) AS v
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily o, hoje
  WHERE o.date BETWEEN trunc(hoje.d, 'MM') AND hoje.d),
mtd_n AS (
  SELECT SUM(o.precip_total) / 30 AS v
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily o, hoje
  WHERE o.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020 AND o.month = MONTH(hoje.d) AND o.day <= DAY(hoje.d)),
w7 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.precip_total), 0) AS v
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily o JOIN dias7 ON o.date = dias7.dd),
w7_n AS (
  SELECT SUM(o.precip_total) / 30 AS v
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_daily o
  JOIN dias7 ON o.month = MONTH(dias7.dd) AND o.day = DAY(dias7.dd)
  WHERE o.year BETWEEN 1991 AND 2020)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN mtd_n.v < 0.5 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN mtd.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN mtd.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(mtd.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(mtd.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · média: ', REPLACE(CASE WHEN mtd_n.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN mtd_n.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(mtd_n.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(mtd_n.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm')
    WHEN ABS((mtd.v / mtd_n.v - 1) * 100) < 5 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN mtd.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN mtd.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(mtd.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(mtd.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · na média')
    WHEN (mtd.v / mtd_n.v - 1) * 100 > 0 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN mtd.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN mtd.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(mtd.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(mtd.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · ', CAST(ROUND((mtd.v / mtd_n.v - 1) * 100) AS INT), '% acima da média')
    ELSE CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN mtd.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN mtd.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(mtd.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(mtd.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · ', CAST(ROUND(-(mtd.v / mtd_n.v - 1) * 100) AS INT), '% abaixo da média')
  END AS `Chuva no mês`,
  CASE
    WHEN w7_n.v < 0.5 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN w7.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN w7.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(w7.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(w7.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · média: ', REPLACE(CASE WHEN w7_n.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN w7_n.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(w7_n.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(w7_n.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm')
    WHEN ABS((w7.v / w7_n.v - 1) * 100) < 5 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN w7.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN w7.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(w7.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(w7.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · na média')
    WHEN (w7.v / w7_n.v - 1) * 100 > 0 THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN w7.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN w7.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(w7.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(w7.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · ', CAST(ROUND((w7.v / w7_n.v - 1) * 100) AS INT), '% acima da média')
    ELSE CONCAT(REPLACE(CASE WHEN w7.v = 0 THEN '0' WHEN w7.v < 10 THEN CAST(ROUND(w7.v, 1) AS STRING) ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND(w7.v) AS INT) AS STRING) END, '.', ','), ' mm · ', CAST(ROUND(-(w7.v / w7_n.v - 1) * 100) AS INT), '% abaixo da média')
  END AS `Chuva 7 dias`
FROM mtd, mtd_n, w7, w7_n

datasets.name: tn01
datasets.displayName: Temperatura de hoje vs média 1991–2020 (±7 dias)
queryLines:

  hour                                          AS hora,
  ROUND(CAST(temperature_2m AS DOUBLE), 1)      AS temperatura,
  ROUND(temp_climatologica, 1)                  AS normal

datasets.name: en01
queryLines:
-- ENSO atual (último trimestre publicado pela NOAA CPC) e tendência
WITH u AS (
  SELECT season, year, oni, fase, intensidade, center_month,
         oni - LAG(oni) OVER (ORDER BY center_month) AS variacao
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.enso_oni
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    CASE fase WHEN 'El Niño' THEN '🔴 ' WHEN 'La Niña' THEN '🔵 ' ELSE '⚪ ' END,
    fase,
    CASE WHEN intensidade IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' ', intensidade) ELSE '' END,
    ' (', CASE WHEN oni >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END,
    REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(oni, 1) AS STRING), '.', ','), ')')        AS `ENSO`,
  CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN variacao >  0.1 THEN '📈 Aquecendo'
         WHEN variacao < -0.1 THEN '📉 Esfriando'
         ELSE '➡️ Estável' END,
    ' · ', season, '/', year)                                    AS `Tendência`
FROM u
ORDER BY center_month DESC
LIMIT 1

datasets.name: en02
queryLines:
-- ONI dos últimos 15 anos; limiares de El Niño (+0,5) e La Niña (−0,5)
SELECT
  CAST(center_month AS DATE) AS ano,
  oni,
  0.5                        AS limiar_el_nino,
  -0.5                       AS limiar_la_nina
FROM weather_pipeline.silver.enso_oni
WHERE center_month >= add_months(current_date(), -12 * 15)
ORDER BY center_month

datasets.name: ld01
queryLines:
-- Acurácia por antecedência (produção, champion atual): todas as previsões do
-- histórico × chuva observada; ⏳ enquanto a faixa tiver menos de 48 horas avaliadas
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT max_by(modelo, inferencia_local) AS modelo FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml_history
),
b AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_model_accuracy_by_lead l JOIN atual a ON l.modelo = a.modelo
),
faixas AS (SELECT explode(array('01–06 h', '07–12 h', '13–18 h', '19–24 h')) AS faixa_antecedencia),
agg AS (
  SELECT faixa_antecedencia, count(*) AS n,
    sum(CASE WHEN pred_vai_chover = 1 AND choveu = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vp,
    sum(CASE WHEN pred_vai_chover = 1 AND choveu = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fp,
    sum(CASE WHEN pred_vai_chover = 0 AND choveu = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fn,
    sum(CASE WHEN api_vai_chover = 1 AND choveu = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS avp,
    sum(CASE WHEN api_vai_chover = 1 AND choveu = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS afp,
    sum(CASE WHEN api_vai_chover = 0 AND choveu = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS afn
  FROM b GROUP BY faixa_antecedencia
)
SELECT
  f.faixa_antecedencia                                              AS `Antecedência`,
  COALESCE(n, 0)                                                    AS `Horas avaliadas`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n, 0) < 48 THEN '⏳'
       ELSE COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(2 * vp / NULLIF(2 * vp + fp + fn, 0), 3) AS STRING), '—') END   AS `F1 modelo`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n, 0) < 48 THEN '⏳'
       ELSE COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(2 * avp / NULLIF(2 * avp + afp + afn, 0), 3) AS STRING), '—') END AS `F1 API Open-Meteo`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n, 0) < 48 THEN '⏳'
       ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(vp * 100 / NULLIF(vp + fp, 0), 1), '%'), '—') END             AS `Precisão modelo`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(n, 0) < 48 THEN '⏳'
       ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(vp * 100 / NULLIF(vp + fn, 0), 1), '%'), '—') END             AS `Recall modelo`,
  (SELECT modelo FROM atual)                                        AS `Modelo`,
  (SELECT date_format(min(target_time), 'dd/MM') FROM b)            AS `Avaliado desde`
FROM faixas f
LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.faixa_antecedencia = f.faixa_antecedencia
ORDER BY f.faixa_antecedencia

datasets.name: rg01
datasets.displayName: Chance de chuva medida — próxima hora (modelo regional INMET)
queryLines:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN prob_chuva_medida IS NULL THEN '⚪ indisponível'
  ELSE CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN prob_chuva_medida >= threshold_regional THEN '🌧️ Sim · ' ELSE '☀️ Não · ' END,
    CAST(ROUND(prob_chuva_medida * 100) AS INT), '% às ', LPAD(CAST(HOUR(target_time) AS STRING), 2, '0'),
    'h (limiar ', CAST(ROUND(threshold_regional * 100) AS INT), '%)') END AS `Chuva medida`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml
WHERE target_time = (
  SELECT MIN(target_time) FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml
  WHERE target_time > from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')

datasets.name: av01
queryLines:
-- Aviso oficial mais severo ativo para a cidade (INMET — repassado pela Defesa Civil)
WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM weather_pipeline.gold.avisos_cidade),
ativos AS (SELECT * FROM a WHERE situacao = 'ativo'),
topo AS (SELECT * FROM ativos ORDER BY nivel DESC, fim DESC LIMIT 1),
prox AS (SELECT * FROM a WHERE situacao = 'futuro' ORDER BY inicio, nivel DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM ativos) > 0 THEN (
    SELECT CONCAT(CASE nivel WHEN 3 THEN '🔴 ' WHEN 2 THEN '🟠 ' ELSE '🟡 ' END,
                  descricao, ' — ', severidade, ' · até ',
                  DATE_FORMAT(fim, CASE WHEN DATE(fim) = DATE(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) THEN 'HH:mm' ELSE 'dd/MM HH:mm' END),
                  CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM ativos) > 1
                       THEN CONCAT(' (+', (SELECT count(*) FROM ativos) - 1, ')') ELSE '' END)
    FROM topo)
  WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM prox) > 0 THEN (
    SELECT CONCAT('🟢 Nenhum ativo · próximo: ', descricao, ' (', severidade, ') em ', DATE_FORMAT(inicio, 'dd/MM'))
    FROM prox)
  ELSE '🟢 Nenhum aviso ativo'
END AS `Avisos`

datasets.name: av02
datasets.displayName: Avisos oficiais — ativos e próximos (INMET / Defesa Civil)
queryLines:
-- Avisos da cidade (ativos, próximos e encerrados nos últimos 7 dias) × chuva observada × modelos
SELECT
  CASE a.situacao WHEN 'ativo' THEN '⚠️ Ativo' WHEN 'futuro' THEN '🔜 Próximo' ELSE '✔️ Encerrado' END AS `Situação`,
  CONCAT(CASE a.nivel WHEN 3 THEN '🔴 ' WHEN 2 THEN '🟠 ' ELSE '🟡 ' END, a.descricao)          AS `Aviso`,
  a.severidade                                                                                AS `Severidade`,
  DATE_FORMAT(a.inicio, 'dd/MM HH:mm')                                                        AS `Início`,
  DATE_FORMAT(a.fim, 'dd/MM HH:mm')                                                           AS `Fim`,
  COALESCE(CONCAT(REPLACE(CAST(m.chuva_obs_mm AS STRING), '.', ','), ' mm em ', m.horas_observadas, ' h'), '—') AS `Chuva observada`,
  CASE WHEN m.horas_com_previsao > 0
       THEN CONCAT(m.horas_alerta_champion, ' de ', m.horas_com_previsao, ' h') ELSE '—' END   AS `Champion: horas com alerta`,
  CASE WHEN m.horas_com_previsao > 0 AND m.horas_alerta_regional IS NOT NULL
       THEN CONCAT(m.horas_alerta_regional, ' de ', m.horas_com_previsao, ' h') ELSE '—' END   AS `Regional: horas com alerta`,
  a.riscos                                                                                    AS `Riscos`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.avisos_cidade a
LEFT JOIN weather_pipeline.gold.avisos_vs_modelo m ON m.id = a.id
WHERE a.situacao IN ('ativo', 'futuro') OR a.fim >= from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo') - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
ORDER BY CASE a.situacao WHEN 'ativo' THEN 0 WHEN 'futuro' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, a.inicio, a.nivel DESC

datasets.name: es01
queryLines:
-- Estação atual (desde 1/jul) vs normal 1991–2020 (view gold.estacao_vs_analogos, atualizada a cada hora)
-- e início da estação chuvosa (gold.estacao_chuvosa, método de Liebmann; recalculado no job semanal)
WITH v AS (
  SELECT * FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos
  WHERE data = (SELECT MAX(data) FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos WHERE tipo = 'atual')
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'atual'      THEN ano_estacao   END) AS ano,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'atual'      THEN chuva_acum_mm END) AS chuva,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p10' THEN chuva_acum_mm END) AS p10,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p50' THEN chuva_acum_mm END) AS p50,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p90' THEN chuva_acum_mm END) AS p90,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'atual'      THEN dias_35_acum  END) AS d35,
    MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p50' THEN dias_35_acum  END) AS d35_n
  FROM v
),
ini AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.provisorio AND e.ano_estacao = p.ano THEN e.inicio END)                        AS inicio,
    PERCENTILE(CASE WHEN e.completa AND e.ano_estacao BETWEEN 1990 AND 2019 THEN e.inicio_dia END, 0.5) AS normal_dia
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_chuvosa e, p
  WHERE e.fonte = 'ERA5'
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(chuva) AS INT), ' mm · ',
    CASE WHEN chuva > p90 THEN '🟦 entre as 10% mais chuvosas'
         WHEN chuva < p10 THEN '🟧 entre as 10% mais secas'
         ELSE 'dentro do normal' END,
    ' (mediana: ', CAST(ROUND(p50) AS INT), ' mm)')                                  AS `Chuva na estação`,
  CONCAT(COALESCE(CONCAT(date_format(inicio, 'dd/MM'), ' (provisório)'), 'ainda não começou'),
    ' · normal: ', date_format(date_add(make_date(ano, 7, 1), CAST(normal_dia AS INT)), 'dd/MM')) AS `Início da estação chuvosa`,
  CONCAT(CAST(d35 AS INT), ' dias · normal até hoje: ', CAST(ROUND(d35_n) AS INT))  AS `Dias com máxima ≥ 35 °C`
FROM p, ini

datasets.name: es02
datasets.displayName: Chuva acumulada na estação — atual, normal e análogos do ENSO
queryLines:
-- Chuva acumulada desde 1/jul: estação atual × normal 1991–2020 (10% mais secas, mediana,
-- 10% mais chuvosas) × mediana dos 5 anos com ONI mais parecido (view gold.estacao_vs_analogos)
SELECT
  data,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'atual'      THEN chuva_acum_mm END), 1) AS atual,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p10' THEN chuva_acum_mm END), 1) AS normal_p10,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p50' THEN chuva_acum_mm END), 1) AS normal_p50,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'normal_p90' THEN chuva_acum_mm END), 1) AS normal_p90,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN tipo = 'analogos'   THEN chuva_acum_mm END), 1) AS analogos
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos
WHERE data <= date_add(DATE(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')), 60)
GROUP BY data
ORDER BY data

datasets.name: es03
datasets.displayName: Estação atual × análogos do ENSO × normal
queryLines:
-- Estação atual × anos com ONI parecido (análogos) × normal: chuva e calor até a mesma data,
-- início da estação chuvosa e totais do ano hidrológico (jul–jun)
WITH hoje AS (SELECT MAX(data) AS d FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos WHERE tipo = 'atual'),
ate AS (
  SELECT v.tipo, v.ano_estacao, v.serie, v.oni, v.trimestre_oni, v.chuva_acum_mm, v.dias_35_acum
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos v, hoje
  WHERE v.data = hoje.d AND v.tipo IN ('atual', 'analogo', 'normal_p50')
),
total AS (
  SELECT tipo, ano_estacao, MAX(chuva_acum_mm) AS chuva, MAX(dias_35_acum) AS d35
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_vs_analogos
  WHERE tipo IN ('analogo', 'normal_p50')
  GROUP BY tipo, ano_estacao
),
est AS (SELECT * FROM weather_pipeline.gold.estacao_chuvosa WHERE fonte = 'ERA5'),
normal_ini AS (SELECT PERCENTILE(inicio_dia, 0.5) AS d FROM est WHERE completa AND ano_estacao BETWEEN 1990 AND 2019),
atual AS (SELECT MAX(ano_estacao) AS ano FROM ate WHERE tipo = 'atual')
SELECT
  a.serie                                                                  AS `Estação`,
  CASE WHEN a.oni IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN a.oni >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END,
                   REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(a.oni, 1), '.', ','), ' (', a.trimestre_oni, ')') END AS `ONI`,
  CAST(ROUND(a.chuva_acum_mm) AS INT)                                      AS `Chuva até hoje (mm)`,
  CAST(ROUND(a.dias_35_acum) AS INT)                                       AS `Dias ≥ 35 °C até hoje`,
  CASE WHEN a.tipo = 'normal_p50'
         THEN date_format(date_add(make_date(atual.ano, 7, 1), CAST(normal_ini.d AS INT)), 'dd/MM')
       WHEN e.inicio IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE CONCAT(date_format(e.inicio, 'dd/MM'), CASE WHEN e.provisorio THEN ' (provisório)' ELSE '' END)
  END                                                                      AS `Início da estação chuvosa`,
  CAST(ROUND(t.chuva) AS INT)                                              AS `Chuva jul–jun (mm)`,
  CAST(ROUND(t.d35) AS INT)                                                AS `Dias ≥ 35 °C jul–jun`
FROM ate a
CROSS JOIN atual
CROSS JOIN normal_ini
LEFT JOIN est e   ON e.ano_estacao = a.ano_estacao
LEFT JOIN total t ON t.tipo = a.tipo AND t.ano_estacao <=> a.ano_estacao
ORDER BY CASE a.tipo WHEN 'atual' THEN 0 WHEN 'analogo' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, a.ano_estacao

datasets.name: en04
queryLines:
-- Dá para prever o trimestre pela fase do ENSO? (gold.enso_previsibilidade: o ONI já publicado
-- prevê o tercil — abaixo / normal / acima — melhor que a climatologia? Teste retroativo, cada ano de fora)
SELECT CONCAT(
  CASE WHEN SUM(CAST(tem_habilidade AS INT)) = 0 THEN '❌ Não: ' ELSE '✅ Em parte: ' END,
  SUM(CAST(tem_habilidade AS INT)), ' de ', COUNT(*), ' testes batem a climatologia (melhor RPSS ',
  REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(MAX(rpss), 2), '.', ','), ')') AS `Previsibilidade`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.enso_previsibilidade

datasets.name: en03
datasets.displayName: ENSO — o que muda em Birigui
queryLines:
-- O que o El Niño e a La Niña mudam em Birigui (gold.enso_impacto): anomalia média do trimestre em que
-- a fase ocorre × demais anos, sem a tendência de longo prazo. Chuva em % da normal.
-- ✳️ = p < 0,05 isolado; com ~740 comparações, nenhum resultado passa na correção para múltiplos testes.
WITH i AS (
  SELECT ordem, trimestre, meses, fonte, grupo, metrica,
         CONCAT(
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(anomalia_pct, anomalia) >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END,
           CASE WHEN metrica = 'tmax_c'  THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(anomalia, 1), '.', ','), ' °C')
                WHEN metrica = 'dias_35' THEN CONCAT(REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(anomalia, 1), '.', ','), ' dias')
                ELSE CONCAT(CAST(CAST(ROUND(anomalia_pct) AS INT) AS STRING), '%') END,
           CASE WHEN p_valor < 0.05 THEN ' ✳️' ELSE '' END) AS txt
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.enso_impacto
  WHERE trimestre <> 'estação chuvosa'
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(trimestre, ' (', meses, ')')                                                                 AS `Trimestre`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'El Niño' AND metrica = 'chuva_mm' AND fonte = 'ERA5'  THEN txt END), '—')         AS `Chuva · El Niño · modelo (1950+)`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'El Niño' AND metrica = 'chuva_mm' AND fonte = 'ANA'   THEN txt END), '—')         AS `Chuva · El Niño · pluviômetros (1950–2024)`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'El Niño' AND metrica = 'chuva_mm' AND fonte = 'INMET' THEN txt END), '—')         AS `Chuva · El Niño · INMET (2007+)`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'La Niña' AND metrica = 'chuva_mm' AND fonte = 'ERA5'  THEN txt END), '—')         AS `Chuva · La Niña · modelo`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'La Niña' AND metrica = 'chuva_mm' AND fonte = 'ANA'   THEN txt END), '—')         AS `Chuva · La Niña · pluviômetros`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'El Niño ≥ moderado' AND metrica = 'tmax_c'  AND fonte = 'ERA5' THEN txt END), '—') AS `Máxima · El Niño ≥ moderado`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN grupo = 'El Niño ≥ moderado' AND metrica = 'dias_35' AND fonte = 'ERA5' THEN txt END), '—') AS `Dias ≥ 35 °C · El Niño ≥ moderado`
FROM i
GROUP BY ordem, trimestre, meses
ORDER BY ordem

datasets.name: en05
datasets.displayName: ENSO — a previsão erra mais com El Niño?
queryLines:
-- A previsão erra mais com El Niño? F1 de "vai chover na hora" (rótulo Open-Meteo), somando só os meses do
-- calendário que têm dados com e sem El Niño — assim não se compara estação seca com chuvosa
-- (view gold.acuracia_por_enso)
WITH a AS (
  SELECT fonte, antecedencia, mes_do_ano, fase = 'El Niño' AS el_nino,
         SUM(acertos) AS tp, SUM(falsos_alarmes) AS fp, SUM(perdidas) AS fn, SUM(horas) AS horas
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.acuracia_por_enso
  GROUP BY fonte, antecedencia, mes_do_ano, fase = 'El Niño'
),
par AS (
  SELECT fonte, antecedencia, mes_do_ano FROM a
  GROUP BY fonte, antecedencia, mes_do_ano HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT el_nino) = 2
),
t AS (
  SELECT a.fonte, a.antecedencia,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.mes_do_ano)                                                        AS meses,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.el_nino THEN a.tp END)     * 2.0 /
           NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.el_nino THEN 2 * a.tp + a.fp + a.fn END), 0)                AS f1_en,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.el_nino THEN a.tp END) * 2.0 /
           NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.el_nino THEN 2 * a.tp + a.fp + a.fn END), 0)            AS f1_outros,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.el_nino THEN a.horas END)                                           AS h_en,
         SUM(CASE WHEN NOT a.el_nino THEN a.horas END)                                       AS h_outros
  FROM a JOIN par USING (fonte, antecedencia, mes_do_ano)
  GROUP BY a.fonte, a.antecedencia
),
fontes AS (SELECT DISTINCT fonte, antecedencia FROM weather_pipeline.gold.acuracia_por_enso)
SELECT
  f.fonte                                                                          AS `Previsão`,
  f.antecedencia                                                                   AS `Antecedência`,
  COALESCE(t.meses, 0)                                                             AS `Meses do ano comparáveis`,
  CASE WHEN t.f1_en IS NULL THEN '⏳ aguardando meses sem El Niño'
       ELSE CONCAT(REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(t.f1_en, 2), '.', ','), ' (', REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(t.h_en, 0), ',', '.'), ' h)') END    AS `F1 com El Niño`,
  CASE WHEN t.f1_outros IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE CONCAT(REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(t.f1_outros, 2), '.', ','), ' (', REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(t.h_outros, 0), ',', '.'), ' h)') END AS `F1 nos mesmos meses sem El Niño`,
  CASE WHEN t.f1_en IS NULL OR t.f1_outros IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN t.f1_en >= t.f1_outros THEN '+' ELSE '' END,
                   REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(t.f1_en - t.f1_outros, 2), '.', ',')) END AS `Diferença`
FROM fontes f
LEFT JOIN t USING (fonte, antecedencia)
ORDER BY f.fonte, f.antecedencia

datasets.name: en06
datasets.displayName: ENSO — acerto da API por mês, com e sem El Niño
queryLines:
-- Mês a mês: F1 da API Open-Meteo (rodada de 1 dia antes) com El Niño × nos mesmos meses sem El Niño.
-- Meses secos têm poucas horas de chuva: um punhado de acertos muda o F1 — olhar a coluna de horas.
WITH a AS (
  SELECT mes_do_ano, fase = 'El Niño' AS el_nino,
         SUM(acertos) AS tp, SUM(falsos_alarmes) AS fp, SUM(perdidas) AS fn,
         CONCAT_WS(', ', ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(CAST(YEAR(mes) AS STRING))))                 AS anos
  FROM weather_pipeline.gold.acuracia_por_enso
  WHERE fonte = 'API Open-Meteo' AND antecedencia LIKE 'd1%'
  GROUP BY mes_do_ano, fase = 'El Niño'
),
f AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN 2 * tp + fp + fn > 0 THEN REPLACE(FORMAT_NUMBER(2.0 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn), 2), '.', ',') END AS f1
  FROM a
)
SELECT
  ELEMENT_AT(ARRAY('Jan','Fev','Mar','Abr','Mai','Jun','Jul','Ago','Set','Out','Nov','Dez'), mes_do_ano) AS `Mês`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN el_nino THEN anos END), '—')         AS `Anos com El Niño`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN el_nino THEN f1 END), '—')           AS `F1 com El Niño`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN el_nino THEN tp + fn END)                     AS `Horas de chuva (El Niño)`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN NOT el_nino THEN anos END), '—')     AS `Anos sem El Niño`,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN NOT el_nino THEN f1 END), '—')       AS `F1 sem El Niño`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN NOT el_nino THEN tp + fn END)                 AS `Horas de chuva (sem El Niño)`
FROM f
GROUP BY mes_do_ano
ORDER BY mes_do_ano

datasets.name: ap01
queryLines:
-- Probabilidade de chuva da própria Open-Meteo (ensemble), hora a hora:
-- a próxima hora e o máximo nas próximas 6 h, com a chuva prevista no período
WITH f AS (
  SELECT observation_time, precipitation, precipitation_probability AS p
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_forecast
  WHERE observation_time >  from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')
    AND observation_time <= from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL 6 HOURS
    AND precipitation_probability IS NOT NULL
),
prox AS (SELECT * FROM f ORDER BY observation_time LIMIT 1),
seis AS (SELECT max(p) AS pmax, sum(precipitation) AS mm FROM f)
SELECT CONCAT(
  CASE WHEN seis.pmax >= 70 THEN '🔴 ' WHEN seis.pmax >= 40 THEN '🟠 '
       WHEN seis.pmax >= 20 THEN '🟡 ' ELSE '🟢 ' END,
  CAST(prox.p AS INT), '% às ', LPAD(CAST(HOUR(prox.observation_time) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'h · até ',
  CAST(seis.pmax AS INT), '% em 6 h · ',
  REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(seis.mm, 1) AS STRING), '.', ','), ' mm') AS `Chance de chuva`
FROM prox CROSS JOIN seis

datasets.name: cel01
queryLines:
-- Sinal de vida gravado a cada hora pelo scripts/inmet_avisos_sync.py (celular, Termux)
WITH s AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(enviado_em) AS t, resultado
  FROM read_files('/Volumes/weather_pipeline/bronze/coletores/celular.json', format => 'json')
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) - unix_timestamp(t)) / 60 > 150
    THEN CONCAT('🔴 Sem contato desde ', date_format(t, 'dd/MM HH:mm'))
  WHEN resultado LIKE 'erro%' THEN CONCAT('🟠 Erro às ', date_format(t, 'HH:mm'))
  ELSE CONCAT('🟢 Ok às ', date_format(t, 'HH:mm'))
END AS `Celular`
FROM s

datasets.name: p48h
datasets.displayName: Próximas 48 h — chuva prevista e chance de chuva
queryLines:
-- Chuva prevista (mm) e chance de chuva: Open-Meteo, champion e regional (24 h), 6 modelos (48 h)
WITH f AS (
  SELECT observation_time, precipitation, precipitation_probability
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_forecast
  WHERE observation_time >  date_trunc('hour', from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo'))
    AND observation_time <= date_trunc('hour', from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) + INTERVAL 48 HOURS
)
SELECT
  f.observation_time                        AS hora,
  ROUND(CAST(f.precipitation AS DOUBLE), 1) AS chuva_mm,
  f.precipitation_probability               AS chance_api_pct,
  ROUND(m.prob_chuva * 100)                 AS champion_pct,
  ROUND(m.prob_chuva_medida * 100)          AS regional_pct,
  ROUND(x.prob_chuva_medida * 100)          AS mos_pct
FROM f
LEFT JOIN weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_ml m ON m.target_time = f.observation_time
LEFT JOIN weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_mos x ON x.target_time = f.observation_time
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: d7d
queryLines:
-- Hoje (observado até agora + previsão) e os 6 dias seguintes, da silver
-- (uma linha por hora; horas futuras = previsão mais recente da Open-Meteo)
WITH hoje AS (SELECT DATE(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')) AS d),
a AS (
  SELECT DATE(c.observation_time)                                  AS dia,
         max(c.temperature_2m)                                     AS tmax,
         min(c.temperature_2m)                                     AS tmin,
         sum(c.precipitation)                                      AS chuva,
         max(c.precipitation_probability)                          AS pmax,
         sum(CASE WHEN c.precipitation >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS horas_chuva,
         max(c.wind_gusts_10m)                                     AS rajada
  FROM weather_pipeline.silver.weather_clean c, hoje
  WHERE DATE(c.observation_time) BETWEEN hoje.d AND date_add(hoje.d, 6)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN dia = hoje.d THEN 'Hoje'
              WHEN dia = date_add(hoje.d, 1) THEN 'Amanhã'
              ELSE element_at(array('Dom', 'Seg', 'Ter', 'Qua', 'Qui', 'Sex', 'Sáb'), dayofweek(dia)) END,
         ' ', date_format(dia, 'dd/MM'))                                          AS `Dia`,
  REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(tmax, 1) AS STRING), '.', ',')                               AS `Máx (°C)`,
  REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(tmin, 1) AS STRING), '.', ',')                               AS `Mín (°C)`,
  REPLACE(CAST(ROUND(chuva, 1) AS STRING), '.', ',')                              AS `Chuva (mm)`,
  CASE WHEN pmax IS NULL THEN '—'
       ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN pmax >= 70 THEN '🔴 ' WHEN pmax >= 40 THEN '🟠 '
                        WHEN pmax >= 20 THEN '🟡 ' ELSE '🟢 ' END, CAST(pmax AS INT), '%') END
                                                                                  AS `Chance máx. de chuva`,
  horas_chuva                                                                     AS `Horas com chuva (≥ 0,5 mm)`,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(ROUND(rajada) AS INT) AS STRING), '—')                       AS `Rajada máx. (km/h)`
FROM a CROSS JOIN hoje
ORDER BY a.dia

datasets.name: mos01
queryLines:
-- MOS multimodelo (17_inference_mos_multimodelo, a cada 3 h): chance de chuva MEDIDA
-- em cada hora de amanhã, combinando ECMWF, GFS, ICON, JMA, GEM e best_match
WITH a AS (
  SELECT * FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_forecast_mos
  WHERE DATE(target_time) = date_add(DATE(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'America/Sao_Paulo')), 1)
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN '⚪ indisponível'
  WHEN sum(pred_chuva_medida) > 0 THEN CONCAT('🌧️ Sim · ', sum(pred_chuva_medida), ' h com chuva · até ',
       CAST(ROUND(max(prob_chuva_medida) * 100) AS INT), '% às ',
       LPAD(CAST(HOUR(max_by(target_time, prob_chuva_medida)) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'h')
  ELSE CONCAT('☀️ Não · máx. ', CAST(ROUND(max(prob_chuva_medida) * 100) AS INT), '% (limiar ',
       CAST(ROUND(max(threshold) * 100) AS INT), '%)')
END AS `Amanhã`
FROM a

datasets.name: mos02
queryLines:
-- Versões do MOS multimodelo (16_train_mos_multimodelo): avaliação com cada estação do
-- INMET fora do treino, nos últimos 12 meses com rótulo, contra a API nas mesmas horas
SELECT
  CONCAT('v', version)                                AS `Versão`,
  date_format(created_at, 'dd/MM/yyyy')               AS `Treinada em`,
  CASE WHEN promoted THEN '✅' ELSE '—' END           AS `Promovida`,
  ROUND(f1, 3)                                        AS `F1 (chuva medida)`,
  ROUND(f1_api, 3)                                    AS `F1 da API (mesmas horas)`,
  ROUND(auc_roc, 3)                                   AS `AUC`,
  CONCAT(CAST(ROUND(threshold * 100, 1) AS STRING), '%') AS `Limiar`,
  test_size                                           AS `Horas de teste`
FROM weather_pipeline.gold.rain_mos_versions
ORDER BY version DESC
